senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. נִיב, תְּנוּבָה)fruits, whence (sub. רֵאשִׁית, מַתְּנַת, v.
units: Ex. XXII, 28) the priest’s share of the produces, T’rumah. Mekh. Mishp. s. 19; Yalk. Ex. 351 T’rumah has three names, Reshith, T’rumah וד׳ and Dema; Tem. 4ᵃ. Ohol. XVI, 4 אוכל בדִמְעוֹ he may partake of his priestly share.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:16">Tosef. Ter. X, 16</cite> <he>בית הד׳</he> place in the barn designated for T’rumah.
